'''2000 Pittsburgh Comicon tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG convention held in Pittsburgh, PA on 29 April 2000. Clay won it. It is known from Jim Li's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d624">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-29-pittsburgh-comicon-4-29-00d624/ pittsburgh-comicon-4-29-00], DeckTech (Jim "Stimmed Jim" Li, 29 April 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-29-pittsburgh-comicon-4-29-00d624/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 29 April 2000
* '''Site:''' Pittsburgh, PA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 24
* '''Winner:''' Clay
